title: Probability of a specified circuit function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ Boolean inputs, gates ordered so each gate reads only earlier vertices, and a valid output vertex. When a Boolean function on the $n$ inputs is chosen uniformly at random, the probability that it agrees with the function computed by $C$ on every input is $2^{-2^n}$.
hypotheses_covered: The gates are ordered so each gate reads only earlier vertices
The output is a circuit vertex
